## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and the technical change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] Android export succeeds
- [ ] Web export succeeds without native-module leakage
- [ ] Android native build succeeds, or the reason it could not be run is documented
- [ ] Camera/gallery behavior was checked on a physical device when relevant

## Safety and product review

- [ ] No result is presented as a confirmed diagnosis
- [ ] Treatment content is unchanged, or a qualified agronomy review is linked
- [ ] Model, label, threshold, or preprocessing changes include tests and update `MODEL_CARD.md`
- [ ] UI changes include accessibility labels and English/Hindi copy where applicable
- [ ] No photo, credential, personal data, or generated native build output was committed
